pre_existing_state_unchanged.gui_ledger_note: This ledger belongs to a previous, closed one-scroll task. It must not be reused or reset for the two-album pilot. Under the current Authorizer this 'must not be reused, must not be reset' rule also means that a NEW task cannot initialize any ledger at all, because the grant gui_ledger path is hard-coded to a single fixed path (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:419-423 and :501-505). That is the second, independent blocker recorded in Issue #27; it is a source-static conclusion and was NOT live-triggered in this round.

ledger_path_collision_note.cyclic_closure: Keeping the existing ledger path is refused by the ledger-initialization layer (src/line_backup_batch/store.py:500, because that path and its gui-ledger-initialization.json receipt are already used), and moving to a new task id with a new ledger path is refused by the Authorizer hard-coded grant binding (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:419-423). The two conditions close each other, so 'new task plus new ledger path' is not feasible under the current authority design.
ledger_path_collision_note.note: Recorded from source reading only. The run was refused at PROJECT_CONTRACT_DRIFT before any ledger initialization was attempted, so this must not be reported as an observed side effect or an observed failure.
